thread:
nina: Quick sync  ran a short shadow of v4.1-int4 vs v4.0-fp16. Overall numbers look fine but the 'longthread' bucket (>=1800 tokens) shows a reproducible hit. Want to lock an anchored canary policy before any traffic-split.

omar: Can you drop the raw counts and the rough delta?

nina: control longthread: 9.4k, variant: 2.1k. Metric: MRR; control 0.389 -> variant 0.364 (rel -6.4%). Bootstrap 95% lower = -0.049. p-value alone isn't telling with these slices.

jess: Thanks. Do we have tokenization / prompt-trunc examples in the top regressions?

nina: Yes — a subset shows KV-merge misalignment after quantized attention merge, and some prompt suffixes appear clipped. I'll attach examples.

samir: High level: we should require three checks for an auto-rollback: (1) per-slice min samples, (2) CI lower bound <= relative threshold, and (3) ensemble confirmation from a second metric (accept_rate or token-level agreement). Otherwise just escalate.

omar: Draft policy sketch (minimal):
```
name: anchored_longthread_gate_v1
global_min: 1000
per_slice_min:
  longthread: 500
metrics:
  - name: mrr
    rel_abort_threshold: -0.03
    min_effect: 0.01
    ci_alpha: 0.05 # use bootstrap 95% CI lower bound
  - name: accept_rate
    rel_abort_threshold: -0.02
sustained:
  window_sec: 1800
  consecutive_windows: 3
hysteresis:
  recovery_windows: 2
  hold_cooldown_hours: 4
auto_rollback: true
notify: channel:#eng-ml pager:oncall
actions_on_flag:
  - dump_top_n_pairs: 200
  - run_eval_diff: true
  - tag_ticket: canary/anchored_longthread_gate_v1
```

jess: I like it. A few specifics: use bootstrap_delta lower bound comparator from Optimize; require both mrr and accept_rate lower bounds to cross thresholds for auto-rollback. For low-volume slices we should prefer human review rather than auto-rollback.

samir: Agree. Add a per-slice auto_rollback_allowed flag. For longthread true; for micro-slices false. Also add an entropy proxy check: if response_entropy decreases >20% AND mrr drops >2% then immediate hold (fast-fail).

nina: Operational flow I propose:
1) Dry-shadow run (no traffic shift).
2) Canary checker computes bootstrap CI for configured metrics per slice.
3) If ensemble condition met and per-slice minima satisfied for N consecutive windows -> deploy-bot posts artifact dump and auto-rollback OR escalate per policy.
4) If only single metric crosses -> post to #eng-ml and page on-call with artifacts.

omar: Implementation notes: Optimize already exposes /eval/bootstrap returning lower/upper percentiles for delta. We need the canary runner to call that per-slice per-metric and to store samples to /artifacts/canary/<ts>/pairs.csv. The runner should also compute token-level alignment diffs for top-200 pairs.

jess: I'll add a tiny wrapper in the smoke-runner: pseudocode:
```
for slice in slices:
  if sample_count(slice) < per_slice_min[slice]:
    continue
  ci = optimize.bootstrap_delta(metric='mrr', control=ctl, variant=var, slice=slice)
  ci2 = optimize.bootstrap_delta(metric='accept_rate', ...)
  if ci.lower <= -0.03 and ci2.lower <= -0.02 and per_slice.auto_rollback_allowed:
    mark_auto_rollback(slice)
  elif ci.lower <= -0.03:
    post_human_review(slice)
```

samir: Also add an oscillation guard: if a rollback occurred in last cooldown hours, suppress auto-promote for that model version until cooldown expires. And add a cap on consecutive_windows (max 5) to avoid infinite waits.

nina: Good. For the artifact dump please include the top 200 worst-regression pairs and a short context snippet for the prompt boundaries so we can triage prompt truncation vs model error.

deploy-bot: [system] I can run a dry-canary run on schedule, post artifacts to /artifacts/canary/2309123456/, and create policy draft 'anchored_longthread_gate_v1'. Confirm schedule?

omar: Let's run dry-canary tomorrow 07:30 UTC. Also add a lightweight smoke check: run N=600 paired evals on the longthread slice before any split >5%.

jess: Will add the N=600 paired runner and token-diff script. The runner will also compute response_entropy and avg_len deltas. If entropy falls >20% and mrr down >2% -> immediate flag.

nina: Action items: nina attach top examples and create the ticket, jess add runner + token-diff, samir wire bootstrap lower-bound comparator into the canary checker and add cooldown guard, omar update policy PR with per-slice auto_rollback flags and cap on windows, deploy-bot schedule dry-canary and post artifacts.

samir: One last suggestion: log a compact 'canary snapshot' with the following fields in the artifact: model_ids, commit_hash, quant_profile, batch_settings, top-10 regressions. That makes postmortems much faster.

nina: Love it. Thanks all. Keep the promo button disabled until the anchored gate is in place. :lock:
